title: Quarterly activation lanes for Private deploys: cohort gating, OKR traceability, and failure buckets
creator: Evelyn Park
description: This ticket captures the quarterly plan and governance model for Private/VPC/on-prem feature rollouts. Goal: define segmented activation lanes (pilot, early-adopter, general availability), map each lane to measurable OKRs, and create explicit failure buckets and risk budgets to guide go/no-go decisions. Deliverables include a tranche schedule, per-lane acceptance criteria, upgrade/rollback playbooks, cross-functional owners, and a dashboard of leading indicators for launch health.
updates: 2026-02-22: Kickoff with Eng, SRE, Solutions, Sales engineering. Agreed on three activation lanes: Pilot (1-3 customers), Early Adopter (5-15 customers), GA (broad).

2026-02-26: Drafted tranche calendar with tentative weeks for pilot start, early-adopter open, and GA freeze. Identified overlapping upgrade windows with major enterprise customers — added buffer week between lanes.

2026-02-28: Engineering proposed incremental compatibility smoke tests to reduce rollback risk; trade-off: adds 2 days to each tranche's preflight. Approved for Pilot and Early Adopter, reevaluate for GA.

2026-03-01: Decision: implement failure buckets (critical, major, minor) tied to action paths. Critical => immediate rollback and incident bridge; Major => canary throttles + patch within 48h; Minor => monitor and schedule next sprint fix. Added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-01: Next steps: finalize dashboard metrics, assign SLO owners for each lane, and schedule a security sign-off with Compliance by 2026-03-10.
comments: PM feedback (Aisha Patel): Ensure OKRs map to quantitative signals (activation rate, onboarding time, rollback frequency) not just qualitative readiness.
Design feedback (Carlos Mendes): Need a simple UI in Console for activation status per tenant; mockups to be delivered by 2026-03-08.
Engineering feedback (Nora Ibrahim): We should pilot a 'degraded' feature flag state that routes to hosted runtime to reduce impact during GA during edge cases.
SRE feedback (Omar Singh): Include MTTR and incident runbook links in the tranche checklist; require post-mortem within 72h for critical failures.
acceptance_criteria: Per-lane SLOs defined and owners assigned
Compatibility smoke tests pass for 3 representative enterprise models
Failure bucket playbooks validated in a tabletop exercise
Security sign-off completed and KMS integration validated
Console activation UI draft reviewed and linked to rollout dashboard
Billing and quota migration path documented for private tenants
